description: This file defines an options parser module for the typeahead.js library, including functions to parse prefetch and remote configurations, and utility functions for handling deferred callbacks.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse options object, applying defaults and validation.

methods.name: parsePrefetch
methods.description: Parses and validates prefetch configuration options.

methods.name: parseRemote
methods.description: Parses and validates remote configuration options.

methods.name: toRemotePrepare
methods.description: Determines the prepare function for remote requests based on configuration.

methods.name: toLimiter
methods.description: Creates a rate limiter function (debounce or throttle) based on configuration.

methods.name: callbackToDeferred
methods.description: Wraps a callback-based function to return a jQuery deferred object.
